forecasts.question: Will Trump nominate Judy Shelton as the next Fed chair?
forecasts.rationale: Trump has formally nominated Kevin Warsh today. Shelton was never on the shortlist and failed confirmation in 2020. Only residual uncertainty if Warsh nomination fails.

forecasts.question: US government shutdown Saturday?
forecasts.rationale: House in recess until Monday makes weekend lapse mechanically near-certain. OPM historically announces even brief shutdowns. Senate vote failed 44-55 Thursday, Graham blocking fast-track.

forecasts.question: Will Trump nominate Kevin Warsh as the next Fed chair?
forecasts.rationale: Resolved YES. Trump formally nominated Warsh on January 30, 2026 via Truth Social and submission to Senate.

forecasts.question: Will Trump nominate Rick Rieder as the next Fed chair?
forecasts.rationale: Effectively resolved NO. Trump nominated Warsh, not Rieder. Only path is Warsh confirmation failure + Trump choosing Rieder as replacement, which is unlikely.

forecasts.question: Will Trump nominate Michelle Bowman as the next Fed chair?
forecasts.rationale: Effectively resolved NO. Trump nominated Warsh. Bowman is currently Vice Chair for Supervision.

summary.notes: Fed chair markets resolved today with Warsh nomination. Shutdown market shows no significant divergence from our forecast.
